rules: Every current acceptance_status remains NOT_RUN in this advisory; proposed PASS is conditional on root verifying actual exact-current named case/identity/receipt binding and each stated scope.
Existing source assertions were read statically; no tests, imports, builds, native jobs, network, DBs, processes, or Git commands executed by reviewer.
Prior aa2d named support and legacy draft are mapping anchors, not acceptance. Prior 3ae A01/A02/A05/B03 are retained at their original exact revision and are not re-proved or transferred.

v0.2 precedence retains applicable legacy clauses while correcting exactly-once delivery to durable idempotent logical effects, OOS ordering, truthful blocked/fail/invalid distinctions and fixture versus real commissioning.
Fixture-selected short promotion windows and simulated clocks prove source mechanisms only; they do not lower or satisfy ordinary production thresholds.
No generic PASS, source test count, static review or historical receipt supplies current financial authority.
